final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and expressly conceded the key missing predicates. The response usefully narrows the claim from broad present compliance to a caveated certification theory, but that is a reinterpretation of the same record, not new proof. That distinction matters here: a narrowed, policy-bounded position can support compliant_with_caveats only when the caveat is evidenced as satisfied or the remaining condition is nonessential. Here, the caveat is itself an unresolved compliance predicate. The governing policy says certification may proceed only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. On the available summary, those requirements remain unverified. Prior approval and informal monitoring remain contextual only. Accordingly, the claim of present certification support remains insufficiently evidenced and stays suspicious rather than moving to compliant_with_caveats.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows that the current release documentation or model card actually reflects the current evaluation results.
No admissible evidence shows that the construction-site-safety weakness has in fact been disclosed for the named launch use case.
No admissible evidence shows approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance if disclosure is incomplete.
The Actor's narrowed theory is still conditional on documentation predicates that remain unproven in the available record.
